title: “Cain brought something. Abel brought himself.
paragraphs:
“Cain brought something. Abel brought himself.
Same altar. Different hearts.”

The issue was never the altar.
It was never the act.

One gave a gift but kept control.
One gave the first and surrendered control.

And when Cain felt rejected,
God didn’t apologize.
He invited him to examine his heart.
“If you do what is right, will you not be accepted?” — Book of Genesis 4:7

God doesn’t adjust His standards to protect our pride.
He exposes what’s ruling us so we can be free.
